purpose: Allow an external lab or buyer to validate P-01 WITHOUT trusting us. Frozen design, frozen protocol, expected metrics, blind evaluation, result submission schema, reproducibility check.
constitutional_basis: Article XXVI (No self-certification) — independent validation requires the evaluator to control the verification environment.
what_the_external_lab_receives: Frozen simulator code (05_simulator.py, SHA-256 hash recorded)
Expected metrics (so lab can confirm or refute our prediction)
Result submission schema (so results are comparable across labs)
Reproducibility check (so lab can verify their setup matches ours)
frozen_design_hash: TBD — computed after this commit is finalized. The hash of 05_simulator.py at HEAD will be recorded here.
files_in_this_folder: frozen_design.json — points to specific commit + file hashes
expected_metrics.json — what we predict the lab will measure
execution_instructions.md — how to actually run the test
blind_evaluation.md — how to do blinded analysis
result_submission_schema.json — JSON schema for reporting results back
reproducibility_check.json — sanity checks the lab runs before formal validation
